test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Words given on the left side of (::) are related with each other by some Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/Relation.

Clerk : Office :: ?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Clerk performs his duty in office.

Similarly,

Warrior makes battle in battle field.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Warrior : Battle field".**
